title: Business Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a **Business Analyst** with 6 months–1 year of experience in an IT/software development environment. The ideal candidate should be strong in **requirement gathering, business analysis, documentation, client communication, and coordination with technical teams**.

Key Responsibilities

* Gather, analyze, and document **business and functional requirements** from clients and stakeholders.
* Conduct **requirement discovery sessions, client calls, and stakeholder discussions**.
* Translate business requirements into **BRDs, FRDs, user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria**.
* Analyze business processes and identify gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.
* Work closely with **developers, UI/UX designers, QA, project managers, and technical teams** to ensure clear understanding of requirements.
* Create **process flows, workflows, wireframes, and functional specifications** where required.
* Manage requirement changes, scope clarifications, and impact analysis throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support **UAT planning, test case validation, issue clarification, and business acceptance**.
* Track requirements and maintain proper documentation throughout the project.
* Participate in **Agile ceremonies**, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure delivered solutions align with **business objectives and client requirements**.

Required Skills

* **6 months–1 year of experience as a Business Analyst** in an IT/software development company.
* Strong experience in **requirement gathering, analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management**.
* Hands\-on experience with **BRD, FRD, SRS, user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria**.
* Good understanding of **SDLC, Agile/Scrum, and software development processes**.
* Basic understanding of **APIs, databases, web applications, and mobile applications**.
* Strong client\-facing and communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical requirements clearly to **developers and non\-technical stakeholders**.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and documentation skills.
* Experience with tools such as **Jira, Confluence, MS Visio, Figma, Balsamiq, or similar**.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

At FIS, our technology and our people are moving forward. We advance the way the world pays, banks and invests. We believe in building inclusive, diverse teams. Together, we innovate to help our colleagues, clients and communities succeed. If you’re ready to grow your career and make an impact in fintech, we have one question: Are you FIS?

**About the Role**


As a Facilities / Maintenance Analyst Senior, you will be responsible for overseeing day\-to\-day facility operations, maintenance activities, and workplace services while driving data\-driven decision\-making through reporting and analytics. The role focuses on monitoring operational performance, managing facility service delivery, developing Power BI dashboards, and generating actionable insights to improve workplace efficiency, compliance, and asset reliability. You will work closely with facility teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure smooth operations, service excellence, and effective management reporting.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Monitor and coordinate daily facility operations, maintenance activities, and workplace services to ensure uninterrupted business operations.
* Track preventive and corrective maintenance activities and ensure timely closure of work orders and service requests.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards for facilities, maintenance, occupancy, energy consumption, and operational performance reporting.
* Generate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports highlighting key facility KPIs, trends, risks, and action items.
* Analyze facility operational data to identify performance gaps, cost\-saving opportunities, and process improvement initiatives.
* Monitor vendor performance, service\-level compliance, and maintenance deliverables through data\-driven reporting.
* Support asset management activities, including asset tracking, maintenance records, and lifecycle monitoring.
* Manage work order management systems, ensuring accurate data capture, reporting, and dashboard visibility.
* Coordinate facility inspections, compliance audits, and maintenance reviews, ensuring adherence to safety and regulatory requirements.
* Track critical infrastructure performance, including electrical systems, HVAC, UPS, fire safety systems, and workplace utilities.
* Prepare management presentations and executive reports to communicate operational performance and key business insights.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to support workplace readiness, business continuity, space utilization, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Ensure facility documentation, maintenance records, operational procedures, and reporting databases remain updated and accurate.

**What You Bring**

* Experience in facilities management, building operations, maintenance coordination, or workplace services.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Power BI, data visualization, dashboard development, and management reporting.
* Proficiency in analyzing operational and maintenance data to drive performance improvements and informed decision\-making.
* Knowledge of facility management systems, work order platforms, and asset management processes.
* Experience preparing MIS reports, KPI scorecards, trend analysis, and executive\-level presentations.
* Strong understanding of facility infrastructure, including electrical systems, HVAC, UPS, fire and life safety systems, and workplace services.
* Ability to monitor and manage vendor performance through measurable service metrics and reporting.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power Query, Power BI, and other reporting tools.
* Demonstrated experience managing facilities, building operations, maintenance programs, or related operational functions.
* Strong knowledge of building systems, utilities, mechanical equipment, and facility infrastructure.
* Experience developing and implementing preventive maintenance and asset management strategies.
* Ability to analyze operational data, identify root causes, and drive process improvements.
* Experience managing contractors, vendors, and service\-level performance.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously.
* Knowledge of workplace safety practices, regulatory compliance requirements, and risk management principles.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* 12\-15 years of experience in Facility operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Postgraduate in any stream.
* Knowledge of sustainability, energy management, and building efficiency programs.
* Experience managing facility renovation, expansion, or infrastructure upgrade projects.
* Familiarity with performance reporting, business analytics, and maintenance KPI development.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Simon \& Schuster is a global leader in general interest publishing, dedicated to providing the best in fiction and nonfiction for readers of all ages, and in all printed, digital, and audio formats. Its distinguished roster of authors includes many of the world’s most popular and widely recognized writers, and winners of the most prestigious literary honors and awards. It is home to numerous well\-known imprints and divisions such as Simon \& Schuster, Scribner, Atria Books, Gallery Books, Pocket Books, Adams Media, Simon \& Schuster Children’s Publishing and Simon \& Schuster Audio and international companies in Australia, Canada, India, and the United Kingdom, and proudly brings the works of its authors to readers in more than 200 countries and territories. For more information visit our website at www.simonandschuster.com.
  
  

The Role
  
Simon \& Schuster is investing in Data \& Decision Intelligence to build a decision ecosystem in which data, tools, and data\-driven automation are embedded in how work gets done every day \- enabling faster, more informed decisions across the company.
  
We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer to help turn that commitment into trusted, reusable data products across publishing, sales, marketing, finance, and operations. This senior hands\-on role combines analytics engineering, business partnership, and responsible use of AI to deliver governed data models, consistent metrics, and scalable self\-service analytics.
  
What You Will Do
  
* Build trusted data products. Develop scalable transformation pipelines, dimensional models, curated data marts, and reusable datasets for reporting, forecasting, experimentation and AI\-enabled use cases.
* Create consistent metrics. Partner with business leaders to define critical measures and encode consistent business logic so teams work from shared definitions across dashboards, analyses, applications, and AI experiences.
* Engineer for trust. Apply automated testing, documentation, lineage, monitoring, code review, and data\-quality controls; resolve issues at their root cause.
* Enable responsible AI. Use approved AI tools to accelerate delivery, prepare governed data for AI applications, and validate generated outputs for accuracy, explainability and business fit.
* Automate manual processes. Partner with business and operations teams to replace repetitive, data\-intensive workflows with reliable, monitored automation that improves speed, accuracy, control, and employee capacity.
* Modernize analytics. Transition fragmented or legacy reporting into governed data products and self\-service experiences while maintaining business continuity and controlling platform cost.
* Lead through influence. Translate ambiguous questions into practical solutions, communicate recommendations clearly, mentor colleagues, and raise team engineering standards.
* Partner across the enterprise. Work with stakeholders in publishing, sales, marketing, finance, operations, supply chain, and technology, including globally distributed colleagues.
* Drive adoption. Document solutions, explain data products in business language, and coach users to confidently interpret and apply data


What You Bring
  
* 5\+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, BI engineering, or a related data role.
* Advanced SQL, dimensional modeling, and experience with structured and semi\-structured data.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud data platform and transformation framework, such as Snowflake and dbt or comparable technologies.
* Practical Python skills and experience with Git, modular design, testing, code review, CI/CD, and production support.
* Experience defining governed business metrics and delivering analytics through Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable platform.
* Strong business partnership, communication, and problem\-solving, with sound judgment around sensitive data and AI\-assisted tools.
* Experience mentoring colleagues and improving team practices through feedback and shared standards.


Preferred
  
* Experience with semantic layers, observability, metadata, lineage, or data contracts.
* Experience with commercial, supply chain, and marketing analytics
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting and enabling governed self\-service analytics.
* Familiarity with generative AI, or AI\-product evaluation.
* Publishing, media, retail, or consumer\-products experience
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or technical field, or equivalent practical experience.


Will Be Measured
  
* Business teams trust and adopt shared data products and metric definitions.
* Critical pipelines and models are reliable, observable, documented, and cost\-efficient.
* Decision cycles become faster, with less manual reconciliation and duplicate reporting logic.
* Manual processes are reduced through reliable automation with measurable improvements in cycle time, accuracy, controls, and employee capacity.
* AI\-enabled analytics are grounded in governed data and produce explainable, validated results.
* Team engineering standards improve through your technical leadership and mentoring.


An Inclusive Workplace
  
We welcome candidates with different paths and perspectives. If you do not meet every preferred qualification, we still encourage you to apply if you believe you can succeed in the role and contribute to our team.
